title: Tech office in San Francisco
assumptions: A new LLC opens a software company's office in San Francisco, builds out the floor and hires staff.

items.name: Articles of Organization (California LLC)
items.quote: Articles of Organization Limited Liability Company (LLC) Filing Fee - $70.00

items.name: Statement of Information (California LLC)
items.quote: Failure to file the required Statement of Information with the Secretary of State as outlined in statute may result in penalties

items.name: Application for Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.quote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: Seller's permit
items.agency: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration
items.condition: Only when the business sells taxable goods (retail products, parts) from the location.
items.quote: Every location must have this permit to sell taxable goods.
items.agencyMatch: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration

items.name: San Francisco Business Registration Certificate
items.agency: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer and Tax Collector
items.quote: In general, businesses must register if any of the below statements are true: Maintain a fixed place of business within San Francisco .
items.agencyMatch: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer and Tax Collector

items.name: Registration Form for Commercial Employers
items.quote: If you operate a business and hire employees or household workers, you must register as an employer within 15 days when:

items.name: Workers' compensation insurance
items.agency: California Department of Industrial Relations, Division of Workers' Compensation
items.quote: California employers are required by law to have workers' compensation insurance, even if they have only one employee.

items.name: Building permit for a tenant improvement
items.agency: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection
items.quote: Building permit projects must be sent to the required permitting agencies.
items.agencyMatch: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection

items.name: Sign and awning permit
items.agency: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection
items.condition: Only with an exterior sign or awning.
items.quote: Most exterior business signs and all awnings require a permit.
items.agencyMatch: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
Formula retail affidavit
mustNotInclude.why: San Francisco's formula retail controls are for retail sales and service uses, not an office.
